name: Differentiable Ray Marching (Taichi)
definition: A differentiable volume rendering technique implemented in Taichi using fixed-step ray marching and trilinear interpolation on a 3D density grid.
summary: Differentiable Ray Marching is a Taichi-based volume rendering technique using fixed-step traversal and explicit alpha accumulation, distinguished by its reliance on Taichi's autodiff engine rather than PyTorch.
